nodes.title: stambh/tally read: the number line under a miss has one scale per level, from the fade alone: 0 to twice the largest row the fade serves, up to the next ten (40, 70, 100); never from her number or the key; a number past the end stands at the end. Reverse if: children read the line as a ruler to count the key off (then drop the line and keep the first-miss arrow only).

kon/place gate 1: a scale number not wholly on the board is not drawn (with its tick's other number); measure's miss arm stops inside the inner number ring and is not drawn from her second placed miss (the law counts placedMisses); draw's miss chip names the corner only (∠O / ∠A, no number); the rim dot is a hollow ring; the loose protractor rests at PD + 8 with every point 6 board px inside the board. Reverse if: children cannot tell from the chip alone which angle they made (then the arc only, never a printed size).
